title: Q-STALL-unlearn-beat: clock unlearn-beat stopped and restarts did not take
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** clock `unlearn-beat` stopped (last beat age None s, expected every 3600 s) and 2 restarts did not take
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation resilience --probe unlearn-beat
**Status:** open

RESILIENCE-1: find why the clock stopped (disabled schedule, failing job, dead route), fix the cause, and add a second independent trigger so it cannot stop silently again. Escalated through the queue, never by email.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation resilience --probe unlearn-beat` reports ticking.
